title: CAD QA
description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 09/17/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Technology
* Work Experience 3\-4 years
* City Pune City
* State/Province Maharashtra
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 411057
### **About Us**


nCircle Tech Private Limited (Incorporated in 2012\) empowers passionate innovators to create impactful 3D visualization software for desktop, mobile and cloud. Our domain expertise in CAD and BIM customization is driving automation with the ability to integrate advanced technologies like AI/ML and AR/VR, which empowers our clients to reduce time to market and meet business goals. nCircle has a proven track record of technology consulting and advisory services for AEC and Manufacturing industry across the globe. Our team of dedicated engineers, partner ecosystem and industry veterans are on a mission to redefine how you design and visualize.  

### **Job Description**


We are looking for a detail\-oriented and proactive QA Manual/Automation Engineer with experience in Selenium, Python scripting, and Manual Testing. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing and executing test strategies, developing automation frameworks, identifying defects, and ensuring the delivery of high\-quality software products. The candidate should possess strong analytical skills and a thorough understanding of software testing methodologies.  

  

**Key Responsibilities*** Design, develop, and maintain Manual, automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver and Python.
* Execute manual and automated testing for CAD Applications applications.
* Analyze business and technical requirements to create comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, system, and smoke testing.
* Identify, document, track, and verify software defects using defect management tools.
* Develop and maintain reusable test automation frameworks and scripts.
* Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, and product teams to ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Participate in test planning, estimation, and execution activities.
* Generate test execution reports and provide quality metrics to stakeholders.
* Continuously improve testing processes, automation coverage, and quality standards.

### **Requirements**

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**  

* 2 to 5 years of experience in Automation and Manual Testing in Software Testing/QA.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Manual, CAD Software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Selenium WebDriver for test automation.
* Proficiency in Python programming and script development.
* Solid experience in Manual Testing, including test case design and execution.
* Good understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.
* Experience with defect tracking and test management tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps, TestRail, etc.).
* Knowledge of API testing using tools such as Postman is desirable.
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

**Preferred Skills**  

* Experience CAD QA, Manual QA, Automation.
* Knowledge of automation frameworks such as PyTest or Unit test.
* Exposure to SQL and database testing.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

title: QA Engineer
description:
**Quality Engineer**  

Unlock your potential with Dassault Systèmes, a global leader in Scientific Software Engineering, as a **Quality Engineer** in **Pune****, Maharashtra!**  

At Dassault Systèmes, we empower our employees and support their passion to change the world and create the future. "We are seeking an experienced candidate to join the SolidWorks  

QA Engineering Team. SOLIDWORKS leads the global 3D computer\-aided design (CAD) industry with easy\-to\-use 3D software that trains and supports the world's engineering and design teams  

as they drive tomorrow's product innovation. As part of this team you will be responsible for the research and development in SolidWorks product to produce high quality, high performance  

CAD software on the Windows platform. Candidates are required to have a strong background in SOLIDWORKS design / 3DModelling with Enovia / Design with any other CAD software.


Do you enjoy challenge? Here a Dassault Systèmes, we empower people with passion to change the world. Ready to challenge the status quo? Shape your career with 3DS


This position can be based in Pune, India

**Role Description \& Responsibilities:**  

* As a member of the Software Quality Engineering team at Dassault Systemes India, the Engineer would have to articulate, demonstrate and prove the value of the SOLIDWORKS Solutions to


our partners/customers to support the QA plan.  

* He/she would be responsible for engaging and developing the Professional Solutions for the Product
* The QA Engineer will work as part of a team responsible for guaranteeing customer satisfaction with the SolidWorks design environment by providing quality assurance


evaluation from initial design to product release.  

* Validation of quality will include active participation in testing requirements in functionality, usability, performance, workflow, and robustness.
* This individual will work closely with the application development team to help quickly identify and resolve problems, while actively participating


in improving QA process definition within the organization.  

* This position will be responsible for creating test designs, running/reviewing automated tests, performing interactive testing that emulates customer workflows, and reporting/verifying


problems.  

* Capitalize on feedbacks from incidents reported by customers to continuously improve the testing process (content and efficiency)
 **Qualifications:**  

* B.E. / M.E. in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline from premier institutions with good academic track records.
* 2 \- 5 years of technical experience in mechanical design, or testing design software
* Experience with 3D CAD software packages like SolidWorks or any other cad.
* Experience on 3DEXPERIENCE Platform or any other PLM tool.
* Having experience on automation or programming language like Python will be added advantage.
* Having experience on Agentic AI will be added advantage.
* Having SOLIDWORKS Certifications like Certified SOLIDWORKS Expert (CSWE) or Certified SOLIDWORKS Profession (CSWP) will be added advantage.
* Must be detail\-oriented with demonstrated analysis and follow\-through skills
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Must be a self\-starter who works equally well independently and in a team environment
* Ready to take challenges.
**Inclusion statement**
-----------------------


As a game\-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

**Job Description**

Job Title: Senior QA Engineer – Tungsten TotalAgility (Banking \& Financial Services) Department: Quality Assurance \& Testing Employment Type: Full\-time Role Overview We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer specializing in Tungsten TotalAgility (formerly Kofax TotalAgility / KTA) to join our Financial Services Quality Assurance team. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end testing of intelligent document processing (IDP), AI capture engines, and business process management (BPM) workflows across high\-risk banking domains—including mortgage pre\-condition review, loan origination, KYC/AML validation, and accounts payable. You will work closely with solutions architects, Tungsten developers, and business analysts to design robust test strategies, validate OCR extraction accuracy against strict SLA targets, test core banking API integrations, and ensure strict compliance with financial security and data privacy standards. Key Responsibilities


Tungsten Extraction \& AI Model Benchmarking Design and run test cases to measure OCR accuracy, field\-level data extraction, and Straight\-Through Processing (STP) rates using golden sample sets of banking documents (structured application forms and unstructured bank statements, payslips, legal deeds).* Test and validate Transformation Designer rules, extraction groups, locators, and AI/ML model thresholds to prevent high defect or miss rates.


Banking Workflow \& Integration Testing Test TotalAgility business process maps, custom work queues, exception routing, and manual validation forms used by bank operations staff.* Validate secure REST/SOAP API integrations connecting Tungsten TotalAgility with core banking systems, CRM databases, or downstream BPM engines to confirm customer data lookups and validation payloads function properly.


Financial Compliance \& Security Validation Ensure automated document workflows comply with banking regulations, data privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA), and Information Security controls.* Execute role\-based access control (RBAC) testing, audit log verification, and data masking/redaction validation on sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII).


Test Automation \& Defect Management Build, execute, and maintain test matrices, test plans, and automated testing scripts (using tools like Postman for API testing and Selenium for workspace UI/validation forms). Log, track, and re\-test platform defects using Jira or Azure DevOps, conducting root\-cause analysis alongside development teams. Required Qualifications \& Experience Domain \& Platform Experience: 4\+ years of QA testing experience specifically with Tungsten TotalAgility (TTA / KTA), Tungsten Transformation Modules (KTM), or Tungsten Capture within a Bank or Financial Services environment. Intelligent Capture Knowledge: Deep understanding of document classification, table extraction, fuzzy logic, and tuning OCR confidence thresholds for high\-volume financial ingestion channels (scanners, secure email, web portals). Technical Skills: Proficiency in testing RESTful and SOAP APIs using Postman, SoapUI, or similar tools. Strong SQL skills to query underlying MS SQL Server databases for backend data validation, job state verifications, and user\-tracking tables. Experience with CI/CD tools and test management software (Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM). Methodology: Proven experience in Agile/Scrum delivery models with strong knowledge of functional, integration, regression, and performance testing strategies.* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.


### **At a Glance**


Work ModeHybrid
EmploymentFull\-time
Experience4–20 yrs
Openings1
LocationPune
DeadlineSep 30, 2026

**What to expect**
------------------

title: QA & Testing Lead Engineer, AVP
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title \-** **QA \& Testing Lead Engineer, AVP**

**Location \- Pune, India**

**Role Description**

* The business which this development team is supporting is the lending department within Private Bank Germany. The whole life cycle for mortgage and consumer loans as well as securitization solutions for these loans is covered within the department and supported by the several teams.
* In the last years we have developed a service layer for common development tasks, the Lending Service Layer (LSL). The Lending Service Layer provides a set of well defined, structured, and reusable Lending Services (APIs) for all internal and external stakeholders. The LSL is in a steady expanding mode to integrate and offer services in a dynamical evolving environment.
* To extend and maintain these services, an experienced Java Developer is required. This role includes the design, implementation, and administration of J2SE/J2EE application code to support business, functional and technical requirements. Furthermore, it includes the analysis of new requirements and supporting business analysts in specifying them in a way that drives reusability and assures that the overall designs are consistent with industry best practices (including scalability, availability, maintainability, and flexibility) and in line with the overall LSL architecture. In case of application issues, the developer should work on analyzing those issues and to neutralize their impacts.
* As an Engineer he is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering significant components of engineering solutions to accomplish business goals. Key responsibilities of this role include active participation in the design of the components, ensuring that solutions are fit for purpose and maintainable, and can be integrated successfully into the overall solution and the LSL environment. Where clear, robust and well tested deployments are in practice.

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy


* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your key responsibilities**

* Test Planning \& Execution:
* Would be expected to carry out below list of Tasks
* Participate on development of holistic Test Approach for the application and all subcomponents
* Build functional/regression tests in Quality Center/ALM
* Carry out test execution and test reporting
* Work on test automation to build regression automation test suite from manual tests and update them for every release.
* Version control artifacts using Bitbucket, Git Hub, Perforce, SVN or any other version control tools
* Schedule automation scripts based on Release cycles.
* Review daily smoke test reports, and Regression test reports. Analyze test failures and raise issues/defects to respective Dev teams.
* Update / Fix test scripts as per the functionality changes
* Achieve good test coverage
* Quality
* Must have good knowledge of the software test best practices and industry standard tools
* Maintaining testing standards and ensure that they adhered to, as well as proactively trying to add these standards whenever possible.
* Taking pride in the quality of software delivered for each iteration and release.
* Communication
* Must be able to communicate effectively with other development team members, project members, managers, and end users.
* Must be able to participate in the discussions within the team, communicating any issues that have a project\-wide scope to the necessary level
* Must be able to participate in a culture of ‘knowledge sharing’ with the development team.
* Motivation
* Must be self\-motivated, setting a high level of professionalism and excellence.

**Your skills and experience**

* You are a senior QA resource with:
* 5\+ Years of functional testing experience
* Good understanding and knowledge of automation testing methodologies
* Good Knowledge of the following: HP ALM, JIRA
* Good knowledge on testing life cycle
* Knowledge in test data maintenance
* Strong working knowledge of SQL and RDBMS databases
* Good knowledge on Unix /Linux environments and basic Unix shell scripting
* Quick learner
* Ability to prioritize and organize
* Results driven – able to deliver good quality accurate solutions to tight time\-scales
* Conscientious – Always give 100% to tasks assigned
* Versatile – Able to multi\-task
* Team Player – Must be able to work with and participate within a large professional team
* Professional – Expect to work the hours the job demands
* Good communication skills
* Good trouble shooting and problem\-solving skills
* It would be desirable for the candidate to have
* ISEB Software Testing Certification – Foundation /Intermediate /Practitioner
* Automated testing skills e.g. Selenium, HP UFT
* Knowledge of Unit Testing and Agile Methodologies Knowledge of scripting (VBScript, Java Scripting, Shell, Perl etc)
* Working experience in Automation and toolset
* You must be highly motivated with an eye for detail, strong communication skills and a track record of delivering successful projects into production.

**Experience / Qualifications:**

* Minimum 5\-8 years relevant experience as QA Engineer within the IT support industry, experience in financial industry preferred.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:


**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.


Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.


We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: QA Analyst-(Salesforce, Java, Selenium)- 3-6Years – Pune
description:
**Ready to take your career global?**


Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Quality Assurance Analyst to join our ever\-evolving Enterprise Operations Team and help us unleash the potential of every business.

**What you’ll own**

We are seeking a highly skilled QA Automation Engineer with expertise in Java, Selenium, TestNG, BDD, Salesforce, and CPQ. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, executing automated test scripts and also perform Functional Testing to ensure the quality and functionality of our software products.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts using Selenium and Java.
* Implement and maintain test frameworks using TestNG and BDD.
* Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and product managers to identify and resolve issues.
* Develop and maintain automated tests for Salesforce and CPQ applications.
* Analyze test results, diagnose issues, and provide detailed reports to the development team.
* Participate in code reviews to maintain the quality and integrity of the test codebase.
* Continuously research and recommend tools and frameworks to enhance the automation process.
* Develop strategies for testing complex features and functionality.

**What you bring**

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3 to 7 years of experience in Selenium automation testing and Java programming.
* Strong understanding of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
* Experience with TestNG and BDD frameworks.
* Familiarity with Salesforce and CPQ applications.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work effectively within a team and independently.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Skills:**

* Selenium
* Java
* TestNG
* BDD (Behavior\-Driven Development)
* Salesforce
* CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote)
* CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab)
* Agile methodologies
* Version control systems (e.g., Git)

**About the team**


Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever\-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

**What makes a Globalpayer?**

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.


Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.
